title: Gradient-Guided Hardware-Native MIXFP4
abstract: arXiv:2611.18769v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Blackwell tensor cores support native inference with 4-bit weights and activations (W4A4), but NVFP4 leaves a perplexity (PPL) gap to BF16. Choosing a format for each 16-element block can improve accuracy, but current matrix multiply instructions cannot execute choices this fine. Applying these rules at hardware-compatible tiles loses most of their benefit. We introduce FlipQuant, which selects E2M1 or E0M3 for each MMA weight tile. It keeps both quantized weight candidates fixed and learns a binary format map from end-to-end gradients of a bucketed KL loss to a BF16 teacher, re-evaluating them after each update. Native kernels execute 16 x 64 tiles on SM120 and 256 x 64 tiles on SM100 with median GEMM overheads of 1.9% and 1.7%, respectively. Across six language models and two corpora, FlipQuant at 16 x 64 closes 42.5% of NVFP4's PPL gap to BF16 on average, compared with 13.3% for FourOverSix. Code is available at https://github.com/b

translated_abstract: Blackwell张量核心支持4位权重与激活的原生推理（W4A4），但NVFP4与BF16相比存在困惑度（PPL）差距。为每个16元素块选择格式可以提升精度，但当前的矩阵乘指令无法执行如此细粒度的选择，而在硬件兼容的瓦片上应用这些规则则会损失大部分收益。我们提出FlipQuant，它为每个MMA权重瓦片选择E2M1或E0M3格式。该方法保持两个量化权重候选固定不变，通过以BF16教师模型为目标的分桶KL损失的端到端梯度学习一个二进制格式映射，并在每次更新后重新评估。原生内核在SM120上执行16×64瓦片，在SM100上执行256×64瓦片，GEMM中位数开销分别为1.9%和1.7%。在六个语言模型和两个语料库上的实验表明，16×64的FlipQuant平均缩小了NVFP4与BF16之间困惑度差距的42.5%，而FourOverSix仅为13.3%。代码可在https://github.com/b获取。
tldr: FlipQuant通过端到端梯度学习为每个MMA权重瓦片选择E2M1或E0M3量化格式，在硬件原生混合精度4位推理中以约1.9%的GEMM开销平均缩小NVFP4与BF16困惑度差距的42.5%，显著优于FourOverSix的13.3%。
en_tdlr: FlipQuant learns a per-MMA-tile binary format map between E2M1 and E0M3 via end-to-end gradients, closing 42.5% of NVFP4's perplexity gap to BF16 with only ~1.9% GEMM overhead in hardware-native mixed-precision 4-bit inference.
